title: American History X
synopsis: A skinhead, a brother who idolizes him, three years inside, and a return to a city that hasn't waited.

nodes.text: A teacher who asks for a paper on a book you would not have chosen.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Honest.
“Refuse” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Pride.

nodes.text: A monologue in the kitchen that becomes an inheritance.

choices.consequence: The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Doubt—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: Murray reads the rewritten paper at a funeral. The room is full and the words are about a brother and a smile and a curb that should not have happened.
You sit in the seat your brother used. You raise your hand a lot. The class learns to listen to you because you have, finally, listened back.
Your mother holds your hand on a sagging step at sunset. Neither of you speaks. The neighbors do not yet trust you. You do not blame them.
